ibps_po_2020_mains_44093f2d::q044.stem: Which of the following can be hypothesized from the above passage? (1 Mark) Travis Kalanick spent most of the past decade turning a taxi app (Uber) into the world's most valuable startup. Uber is ride-hailing service that he helped found in 2009 and built into a transportation colossus. Travis Kalanick stepped down Tuesday as chief executive of Uber, after a seemingly endless series of scandals raised doubts over his leadership. Kalanick’s resignation doesn’t come as a surprise -- after he was caught on video chewing out an Uber driver who questioned the company’s compensation policies in February. Meanwhile, Shareholders released a damning report on the firm's management culture. (I) Uber is a riding service that Chief Executive of Uber helped built into transportation prodigious. (II) Shareholders ordered Travis Kalanick to relinquish position of chief executive of Uber. (III) Holder released a report against firm’s management culture that was condemnatory.

ibps_rrb_2021_mains_5790dd1e::q067.note: Read off the bars: the operators sit between the stacked fractions, and flattening the row dropped them to the end as '20/x^2 = 3 + ... 4/x'. Solving: 3x^2+4x-20=0 gives x = 2 or -10/3; y^2-12y+32=0 gives y = 4 or 8. Every x is below every y, so x < y -- option (d), a definite relation, which is what this question type always has.

ibps_rrb_2021_mains_5790dd1e::q069.note: Three bars on row I (x 351.2-356.5, 366.6-376.5, 392.1-396.9) give 5/x, 12/x^2 and 1/2, with the minus and equals between them. Solving: x^2-10x+24=0 gives x = 4 or 6; 2y^2-13y+20=0 gives y = 2.5 or 4. x >= y throughout -- option (b).

ibps_rrb_2021_mains_e31b8754::q080.note: Bars at y=242.7 give 32/y^2 and 34/3y. Solving: 4x^2-35x+75=0 gives x = 5 or 3.75; 3y^2-34y+96=0 gives y = 6 or 16/3. Every x is below every y, so x < y -- option (b).
